      "band": "P2",

      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Prevents potential busy loops in the socket polling loop caused by unconsumed TCP urgent data and avoids doomed sends or unrequested reads during receive backpressure. As noted in commit a626b28980, 'select() can keep reporting a TCP urgent indication even when recv() has no data to read... disconnect to avoid a busy loop.'"
    },

      "name": "rpc",

      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Ensures HTTP server connections on Windows disconnect promptly when an exceptional condition is detected rather than leaving broken sockets unhandled. This addresses platform-specific socket behavior on the RPC HTTP server without altering the core RPC interface."
